ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.desc: Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage. \n \nAdaptor %i:scaleAP%: If the Ability kills, cast it again.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.desc: Slice the target for @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and applying @WoundLevel@% Wound and @BurnAmount@% Burn for @WoundDuration@ seconds. 
 
Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains @TraitADOnCast@ Attack Damage each cast. 
 
Wound: Reduces healing received. 
Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.desc: Tether the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all enemies in a @AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @SlowPercent@% Slowing them for @SlowDuration@ seconds. \n \nSlow: Reduce Attack Speed

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.desc: Passive: Start combat with @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds. \n \nActive: Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.desc: Active: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a cone. \n \nQuest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. (Forge Power: @Stack@ / @GenericCalc1@)

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.desc: Begin consuming @PercentManaPerSecond@ max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @MRReduction@. \n \nTeal Buff: Gain @TraitManaRegenTooltip@ Mana Regen for every @TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Uproot
ability.desc: Passive: Restore @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting. \n \nActive: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health. 
 
If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power. 
 
Current bonus: @Stack@% %i:scaleAP%

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.desc: Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it. \n \nActive: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.desc: Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.desc:
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @PoisonDurationAP@ seconds. 
 
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Heavily slows the target. 
 
Purple Buff: Every @TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains @TraitTimedAP@ Ability Power.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.desc:
Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 
 
1st Ascension: Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage. 
2nd Ascension: Attacks @ShredLevel@% Shred enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
3rd Ascension: Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit. 
4th Ascension: Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger. 
 
Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.desc: Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@ chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@ per takedown. \n \nActive: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.desc: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% bonus physical damage. \n \nGrey Buff: Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies. 
 
Active: Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 
 
Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.desc: Grant @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to Shen and @ShieldCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to a nearby damaged ally for @MagicShieldDuration@ seconds. Both of their next @NumAttacksBuff@ attacks gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the target. 
 
Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects. 
 
Red: @RedRerolls@ Reroll (Reds Foraged: @Stack@) 
Green: @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health (Greens Foraged: @GenericCalc1@) 
Yellow: @YellowXP@ XP (Yellows Foraged: @GenericCalc2@)

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.desc: Bite the current target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and healing for @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% of the damage dealt. Gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each over the duration.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.desc: Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them. 
 
Active: Gain @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

ability.name: Flock Family

ability.name: Wuju Style

Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed. 
 
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Double Strikes grant @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% stacking Attack Speed. 
 
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist. \n \nWhen the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, increased to up to @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% for each attack while casting. \n \nIf an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.desc: Passive: On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health. \n \nActive: Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is Unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.desc:
Passive: Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex. 
 
Active: Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is Burning. 
 
Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. \n \nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.desc:
Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. 
 
Active: Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Armor. 
 
Red Buff: Attacks @BurnAmount@% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. \n \nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.desc: Passive: Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp. \n \nActive: Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% more damage per curse.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.desc: Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. \n \nAdaptor %i:scaleAD%: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for @ManaReaveFlat@. 
 
Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen. 
 
Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.desc: Passive: Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana. \n \nActive: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each. \n \nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). 
 
The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% Slows them. 
 
Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

ability.desc: Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead. \n \nActive: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target. 
 
Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. 
 
Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack.

Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw. 
 
Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.
